defmodule Forum.Archive.Preparations.ArchiveScope do
  use Ash.Resource.Preparation

  @impl true
  def prepare(query, _, _) do
    case Ash.Query.get_action(query, query.action.name) do
      %{name: :with_archived} -> query
      %{name: :archived} -> Ash.Query.filter(query, not is_nil(archived_at))
      _ -> Ash.Query.filter(query, is_nil(archived_at))
    end
  end
end

defmodule Forum.Archive.Changes.CascadeArchive do
  use Ash.Resource.Change

  @impl true
  def change(changeset, _, _) do
    Ash.Changeset.before_action(changeset, fn cs ->
      if cs.data.archived_at do
        cs
      else
        batch_id = Ecto.UUID.generate()
        archived_at = DateTime.utc_now()
        
        # Archive the target
        cs
        |> Ash.Changeset.change(%{archived_at: archived_at, archive_batch_id: batch_id})
        |> Ash.Changeset.after_action(fn _cs, record ->
          archive_descendants(record, batch_id, archived_at)
          {:ok, record}
        end)
      end
    end)
  end

  defp archive_descendants(record, batch_id, archived_at) do
    resource = record.__struct__
    descendant = case resource do
      Forum.Content.Post -> Forum.Content.Comment
      Forum.Content.Comment -> Forum.Content.Reaction
      _ -> nil
    end

    if descendant do
      fk = case resource do
        Forum.Content.Post -> :post_id
        Forum.Content.Comment -> :comment_id
        _ -> nil
      end
      
      # Find descendants that are not already archived
      descendant
      |> Ash.Query.filter(^ref(fk) == ^record.id and is_nil(archived_at))
      |> Ash.read!(authorize?: false)
      |> Enum.each(fn desc ->
        desc
        |> Ash.Changeset.for_update(:archive, %{}, authorize?: false)
        |> Ash.Changeset.change(%{archived_at: archived_at, archive_batch_id: batch_id})
        |> Ash.update!(authorize?: false)
      end)
    end
  end
end

defmodule Forum.Archive.Changes.CascadeRestore do
  use Ash.Resource.Change

  @impl true
  def change(changeset, _, _) do
    Ash.Changeset.before_action(changeset, fn cs ->
      if cs.data.archived_at do
        batch_id = cs.data.archive_batch_id

        cs
        |> Ash.Changeset.change(%{archived_at: nil, archive_batch_id: nil})
        |> Ash.Changeset.after_action(fn _cs, record ->
          restore_descendants(record, batch_id)
          {:ok, record}
        end)
      else
        cs
      end
    end)
  end

  defp restore_descendants(record, batch_id) do
    resource = record.__struct__
    descendant = case resource do
      Forum.Content.Post -> Forum.Content.Comment
      Forum.Content.Comment -> Forum.Content.Reaction
      _ -> nil
    end

    if descendant do
      fk = case resource do
        Forum.Content.Post -> :post_id
        Forum.Content.Comment -> :comment_id
        _ -> nil
      end

      descendant
      |> Ash.Query.filter(^ref(fk) == ^record.id and archive_batch_id == ^batch_id)
      |> Ash.read!(authorize?: false)
      |> Enum.each(fn desc ->
        desc
        |> Ash.Changeset.for_update(:restore, %{}, authorize?: false)
        |> Ash.Changeset.change(%{archived_at: nil, archive_batch_id: nil})
        |> Ash.update!(authorize?: false)
      end)
    end
  end
end

defmodule Forum.Content.Post do
  use Ash.Resource, domain: Forum.Content, data_layer: Ash.DataLayer.Ets

  ets do
    private? true
  end

  actions do
    defaults [:read]
    create :create do
      accept [:title]
    end
    read :archived do
      prepare Forum.Archive.Preparations.ArchiveScope
      authorize? true
    end
    read :with_archived do
      prepare Forum.Archive.Preparations.ArchiveScope
    end
    destroy :archive do
      change Forum.Archive.Changes.CascadeArchive
      soft? true
    end
    update :restore do
      change Forum.Archive.Changes.CascadeRestore
    end
    destroy :purge do
      change fn changeset, _ ->
        if changeset.data.archived_at do
          changeset
        else
          Ash.Changeset.add_error(changeset, :archived_at, "must be archived before it can be purged")
        end
      end
    end
  end

  attributes do
    uuid_primary_key :id
    attribute :title, :string, allow_nil?: false
    attribute :archived_at, :utc_datetime_usec
    attribute :archive_batch_id, :uuid
  end

  relationships do
    has_many :comments, Forum.Content.Comment, destination_attribute: :post_id
  end

  aggregates do
    count :comment_count, :comments
  end

  policies do
    bypass Ash.Policy.Check.Static.All, [static_condition: false] # Not good, need to do it right.
    # Let me rethink policies.
  end
end

defmodule Forum.Content.Post do
  use Ash.Resource, domain: Forum.Content, data_layer: Ash.DataLayer.Ets

  ets do
    private? true
  end

  actions do
    defaults [:read]
    create :create do
      accept [:title]
    end
    read :archived do
      prepare Forum.Archive.Preparations.ArchiveScope
    end
    read :with_archived do
      prepare Forum.Archive.Preparations.ArchiveScope
    end
    destroy :archive do
      change Forum.Archive.Changes.CascadeArchive
      soft? true
    end
    update :restore do
      change Forum.Archive.Changes.CascadeRestore
    end
    destroy :purge do
      change fn changeset, _ ->
        if changeset.data.archived_at do
          changeset
        else
          Ash.Changeset.add_error(changeset, :archived_at, "must be archived before it can be purged")
        end
      end
    end
  end

  attributes do
    uuid_primary_key :id
    attribute :title, :string, allow_nil?: false
    attribute :archived_at, :utc_datetime_usec
    attribute :archive_batch_id, :uuid
  end

  relationships do
    has_many :comments, Forum.Content.Comment, destination_attribute: :post_id
  end

  aggregates do
    count :comment_count, :comments
  end

  policies do
    policy action_type(:read) do
      policy action(:archived) do
        authorize_if fn actor, _ -> Map.get(actor || %{}, :role) == :admin end
      end
      authorize_if always()
    end
    authorize_if always()
  end
end
